verdict.rationale: MotherDuck ships natural-language interaction via 'Dives' (NL-to-dashboard generation with conversational refinement like 'add a filter for US region') and both local and remote MCP servers that let AI agents run SQL from natural-language prompts without writing SQL themselves; runtime probes confirm the MCP server actually executes real analytical queries end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/community validation specifically of the natural-language accuracy (only vendor docs and technical probes, no hands-on user review of NL command quality).
